name: Coder Vibe Client Handover Checklist
author: oozye2

sections.description:
Client Handover Checklist helps you finish a client site properly. It adds a page under Tools with a tick-box checklist, helpers that detect useful facts about the site, and a clean handover pack you can print or download.

Features

  • Checklist covering admin clean-up, backups, domain/DNS/hosting, plugin licences, analytics and Search Console access, SSL expiry and final testing.
  • Add and delete your own custom checklist items.
  • Progress bar showing how much is complete.
  • Auto-detected administrator accounts, active plugins, and site, WordPress, PHP and theme versions.
  • Handover pack view that prints cleanly using your browser (no external libraries).
  • Download the pack as a standalone HTML or Markdown file.
  • Branding: agency name and logo URL shown on the pack.

Privacy and security

The plugin makes no external requests and has no tracking. Do not store passwords in the notes fields; record only where credentials are kept. All actions require the manage_options capability and a valid nonce. Data is removed when the plugin is deleted.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the coder-vibe-client-handover-checklist folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install through the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Tools > Client Handover.
sections.faq:
Where is my data stored?

In two options in your WordPress database: cvch_data and cvch_settings. They are deleted when you delete the plugin.

Can I store passwords?

No. Please do not. Record only where credentials are kept, such as the name of your password manager vault.

Who can use it?

Only users with the manage_options capability, normally administrators.

Does it contact other websites?

No. The only external resource is the optional logo image you point to, which is loaded by your browser.
